test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following dance awards is organised by the National Institute of Indian Classical Dance?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Abhinandan Saroja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Abhinandan Saroja** is a prestigious dance award organised by the **National Institute of Indian Classical Dance**.
 
• This award is specifically focused on recognising and honouring exceptional contributions in the field of **Indian classical dance.**
 
• The **National Institute of Indian Classical Dance** is an organisation dedicated to the preservation, promotion, and development of **traditional Indian dance forms.**
 
• The award signifies the importance of **Abhinaya**, which is the art of expression in classical dance forms, a crucial element in many Indian dance traditions.
 
• Recipients of this award are often individuals who have shown **excellence in performance**, contributed to teaching, or have played a major role in the propagation of **Indian classical dance.**
 
• It includes performances and contributions across various classical dance forms such as **Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Kathakali.**
 
• The award ceremony is often accompanied by performances that celebrate the diversity and richness of **Indian classical dance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bharata Shastra Nritya Praveena**__

 __
 
• This term refers to a title or recognition given to individuals who excel in the study and practice of **Bharata Shastra**, an ancient text on Indian classical dance and drama.
 
• The **Bharata Shastra**, also known as the **Natyashastra**, is a seminal work by **Bharata Muni** that outlines the principles of Indian classical dance, drama, and music.
 
• However, this is not a specific award associated with the **National Institute of Indian Classical Dance.**
 
 
 
• **Natya Shiromani National**__
 __
 
• **Natya Shiromani** translates to "Crown Jewel of Dance" and may refer to an honorary title or recognition, but it is not specifically linked to the **National Institute of Indian Classical Dance.**
 
• This could denote excellence in dance at a national level but lacks association with the award mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• **Sanatan Sangeet Sanskriti**__
 
 
• **Sanatan Sangeet Sanskriti** refers to the eternal and traditional heritage of Indian music and dance.
 
• This is not an award but rather a broader concept encompassing the cultural and artistic traditions of **Indian classical music and dance.**
